card.name: Overdose and poison-control wording
card.fires_on: Words and symbols in overdose sections where a poison-related word is likely next, such as 'of' after 'management' or 'treatment', the hyphen in the poison control phone number, or the end of a drug name before 'overdoses'.

modes.label: Poison control referral
modes.description: Small words or the hyphen in a phone number inside advice to contact a poison control center.
modes.example: Consider contacting a poison control center (1-800<<->>222-1222

modes.label: Linking words in overdose headings
modes.description: The word 'of' after management, treatment or suspicion, just before an overdose or ingestion term.
modes.example: For more information on the management<< of>> an overdose of carisoprodol

modes.label: Drug name before overdose
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name just before the word overdoses.
modes.example: Ipecac syrup should be avoided in theophyll<<ine>> overdoses.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward poison and toxicity words such as poisoned, poison, toxic and poisoning.
card.plain: It fires in overdose text just before a word like poison or toxic is expected.
